name: DualSense Plus
author: RACiT
description: PS5 DualSense extras: game sounds on the controller speaker, haptic feedback, adaptive triggers, the light bar, motion, and Fire on R2 (Rift Apart layout) with prompts to match. Off: every controller, a DualSense too, plays as a plain pad with the game's own layout and prompts. Your choices in Settings > Controls are kept while it is off.
